name: Jordan Example
headline: Operations Coordinator
summary: Operations coordinator with six years in warehouse planning and supplier follow-up. I keep schedules honest, fix the process behind a late order, and write the report that tells the team what changed.
availability: I can start within one month.

bullets: Plan weekly inbound deliveries for 40 suppliers and agree delivery slots with the warehouse team.
Rebuilt the late-order report in Excel, so planners see each delay and its cause on one page.
Train new team members on the order system and the daily checklist.
Answered customer orders and complaints by phone and e-mail in English and Spanish.
Logged recurring product issues and passed them to the buying team every month.
